info.title: Patreon API v2
info.description:
OpenAPI 3.1 specification for the Patreon API v2, split into subfiles using JSON `$ref` references.

## What's new in v2 vs v1

| Change | Details |
|--------|----------|
| **Members replace Pledges** | The `Member` resource replaces the v1 `Pledge`. Members return richer data including charge status and membership lifetime. |
| **Explicit fields required** | No attributes or relationships are returned by default. All desired fields must be requested via `fields[{type}]=...` |
| **Improved scopes** | Finer-grained OAuth scopes for better security and developer control. |
| **Webhook management** | Clients can create and manage webhooks on campaigns on behalf of creators. |
| **Cursor pagination** | Member and post endpoints use cursor-based pagination via `page[cursor]`. |

## Authentication

All requests require an OAuth 2.0 Bearer token. Complete the authorization flow:
1. Redirect user to `GET https://www.patreon.com/oauth2/authorize`
2. Exchange the authorization code: `POST /api/oauth2/token`
3. Include `Authorization: Bearer {access_token}` on all API requests.

## OAuth Scopes

| Scope | Access granted |
|-------|----------------|
| `identity` | User public profile |
| `identity[email]` | User email address |
| `identity.memberships` | User's own memberships |
| `campaigns` | Campaign data |
| `w:campaigns.webhook` | Create/manage webhooks |
| `campaigns.members` | Campaign member data |
| `campaigns.members[email]` | Member email |
| `campaigns.members.address` | Member shipping address |
| `campaigns.posts` | Campaign posts |

## Requesting Fields

All attributes must be explicitly requested. URL-encode square brackets:

```
GET /api/oauth2/v2/campaigns?fields%5Bcampaign%5D=patron_count,is_monthly
```

## Cursor Pagination

Use `meta.pagination.cursors.next` from a response as the `page[cursor]` parameter to fetch the next page. A null `next` cursor means no further pages.

## Rate Limits

Rate-limited at both client and token level. HTTP 429 responses include `retry_after_seconds`. Refreshing a token does **not** reset rate limits. After 2,000+ bad requests in 10 minutes, a 30-minute block is applied.

## Directory structure

```
openapi.json                          ← root entry point
components/
  schemas/          (19 files)         ← Error, User, Campaign, Member, Tier, Benefit,
  |                                       Address, Post, Webhook, Goal, PaginationMeta,
  |                                       ResourceLinkage, Relationship, JSON:API envelopes
  parameters/       (4 files)           ← fields, include, page[cursor], page[count]
  responses/        (7 files)           ← shared HTTP error responses
  securitySchemes/  (2 files)           ← OAuth2, BearerToken
paths/
  oauth/            (2 files)           ← token exchange + refresh
  identity/         (1 file)            ← GET /identity
  campaigns/        (4 files)           ← campaigns list, single, members, posts
  members/          (1 file)            ← GET /members/{id}
  posts/            (1 file)            ← GET /posts/{id}
  webhooks/         (2 files)           ← webhook CRUD
```

tags.name: OAuth
tags.description: OAuth 2.0 token exchange and refresh. No authentication required on these endpoints.

tags.name: Identity
tags.description: Fetch data about the current authenticated user via their OAuth token.

tags.name: Campaigns
tags.description: Access campaign data — list, single campaign, campaign members, and campaign posts.

tags.name: Members
tags.description: Access individual member records. Members replace v1 Pledges and provide richer data about patron relationships.

tags.name: Posts
tags.description: Access individual post records on campaigns.

tags.name: Webhooks
tags.description: Manage webhooks for real-time campaign event delivery. Supports member lifecycle events and post events.

post.description: Exchange a single-use authorization code for an OAuth 2.0 access token + refresh token pair. Requires `Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded`.
Issue a new access token + refresh token pair using a valid refresh token. Refreshing does **not** reset rate limits.

get.description:
Fetch the current user resource corresponding to the OAuth access token.

**Scopes:** `identity` (required for public profile). `identity[email]` required for the `email` attribute.

**Top-level includes:** `memberships`, `campaign`

**In v2, all fields must be explicitly requested** via `fields[user]=...` and `fields[campaign]=...` etc. Without `fields`, only `id` and `type` are returned.

parameters.name: fields[user]
parameters.description: Comma-separated User attributes to return. E.g. `about,email,full_name,image_url,url,vanity`.

parameters.name: fields[campaign]
parameters.description: Comma-separated Campaign attributes to return when campaign is included.

parameters.name: fields[membership]
parameters.description: Comma-separated Member attributes when memberships are included.

200.description: The current user resource with optional includes.

get.description:
Returns all campaigns owned by the authorized user.

**Scope:** `campaigns`

**Top-level includes:** `tiers`, `creator`, `benefits`, `goals`

All attributes must be explicitly requested via `fields[campaign]=...`

parameters.name: fields[tier]
parameters.description: Tier attributes when tiers are included.

parameters.name: fields[benefit]
parameters.description: Benefit attributes when benefits are included.

parameters.name: fields[goal]
parameters.description: Goal attributes when goals are included.

200.description: List of the authenticated user's campaigns.

get.description:
Fetch a single Campaign by its ID.

**Scope:** `campaigns`

**Top-level includes:** `tiers`, `creator`, `benefits`, `goals`

All attributes must be explicitly requested via `fields[campaign]=...`

Returns all Members for a given Campaign.

**Scope:** `campaigns.members` (required). `campaigns.members[email]` for email. `campaigns.members.address` for shipping address.

**Top-level includes:** `address`, `campaign`, `currently_entitled_tiers`, `user`, `pledge_history`

**Pagination:** Default 1000 results per page (500 if `pledge_history` is included). Use `page[cursor]` from `meta.pagination.cursors.next`.

parameters.name: fields[tier]
parameters.description: Tier attributes when currently_entitled_tiers is included.

get.description:
Returns all posts on a given Campaign.

**Scope:** `campaigns.posts`

All post attributes must be requested via `fields[post]=...`

Fetch a single Member by its UUID.

**Scope:** `campaigns.members`

**Top-level includes:** `address`, `campaign`, `currently_entitled_tiers`, `user`

We recommend including `currently_entitled_tiers` to know exactly what a member is entitled to.

Fetch a single Post by its ID.

**Scope:** `campaigns.posts`

Post content is only available for posts the token holder has access to.

Returns all webhooks created by the current client for the authorized user's campaign. Only webhooks created by your client are visible.

**Scope:** `w:campaigns.webhook`

**Top-level includes:** `client`, `campaign`

post.description:
Create a new webhook on the current user's campaign.

**Scope:** `w:campaigns.webhook`

Webhook payloads are signed: verify the `X-Patreon-Signature` header (HMAC-MD5 hex digest of the body using the webhook secret).

**Available triggers:**
- `members:create` / `members:update` / `members:delete`
- `members:pledge:create` / `members:pledge:update` / `members:pledge:delete`
- `posts:publish` / `posts:update` / `posts:delete`

patch.description:
Update a webhook's triggers, URI, or paused state. Only webhooks created by your client can be updated.

**Scope:** `w:campaigns.webhook`

**Replaying missed events:** If your webhook was down and `num_consecutive_times_failed > 0`, PATCH with `paused: false` to replay all queued missed events.

paused.description: Set false to resume and replay missed events.

delete.description:
Permanently delete a webhook. Only webhooks created by your client can be deleted.

**Scope:** `w:campaigns.webhook`

OAuth2.description: Patreon OAuth 2.0. Complete the flow at https://www.patreon.com/oauth2/authorize and exchange the code at POST /api/oauth2/token.

scopes.identity: Read access to the user's public profile information.
scopes.identity[email]: Read access to the user's email address.
scopes.identity.memberships: Read access to the user's memberships.
scopes.w:campaigns.webhook: Read, write, update, and delete access to campaign webhooks created by your client.
scopes.campaigns.members: Read access to data about a campaign's members. Also enables webhook delivery of member data.
scopes.campaigns.members[email]: Read access to member email addresses. Also enables webhook delivery.
scopes.campaigns.members.address: Read access to member shipping addresses. Also enables webhook delivery.
scopes.campaigns.posts: Read access to posts on a campaign.

BearerToken.description: Creator's Access Token from the Patreon developer portal, or an OAuth2 access token with the required v2 scopes.

fields.name: fields[{resource_type}]
fields.description:
Comma-separated list of attributes to return for a given resource type. **In v2, no attributes are returned by default** — all desired fields must be explicitly requested.

Encode brackets: `fields%5Bcampaign%5D=patron_count,created_at`

**Examples:**
- `fields[campaign]=patron_count,created_at,is_monthly`
- `fields[member]=full_name,patron_status,last_charge_status`
- `fields[tier]=amount_cents,title,patron_count`
- `fields[address]=city,line_1,postal_code`

include.name: include
include.description:
Comma-separated list of relationship paths to include as compound documents in the response.

**Examples:**
- `include=tiers,creator,benefits`
- `include=currently_entitled_tiers,address,user`
- `include=campaign,memberships`

pageCursor.name: page[cursor]
pageCursor.description: Opaque cursor for cursor-based pagination. Obtain from `meta.pagination.cursors.next` in a prior response.

pageCount.name: page[count]
pageCount.description: Number of results per page. Default 1000 for most endpoints; 500 if `pledge_history` is included.

BadRequest.description: 400 Bad Request — Malformed request syntax or invalid parameters.

Unauthorized.description: 401 Unauthorized — Invalid, expired, or missing OAuth access token.

Forbidden.description: 403 Forbidden — Authenticated but missing required scope or insufficient privileges.

NotFound.description: 404 Not Found — The requested resource does not exist.

MethodNotAllowed.description: 405 Method Not Allowed — Invalid HTTP method for this endpoint.

TooManyRequests.description: 429 Too Many Requests — Rate limit exceeded. Check `retry_after_seconds` in the response. Refreshing a token does not reset rate limits.

ServerError.description: 500 Internal Server Error — Unexpected server-side failure. Retry with exponential backoff.

PaginationMeta.description: Pagination metadata returned in JSON:API `meta` object.

next.description: Pass as `page[cursor]` to retrieve the next page. Null when no further pages.

JsonApiSingleResponse.description: JSON:API response with a single primary resource.

JsonApiListResponse.description: JSON:API response with a list of primary resources.

User.description: A Patreon user (API v2). All fields must be explicitly requested via `fields[user]=...`

Campaign.description: A creator's Patreon campaign (API v2). All fields must be explicitly requested via `fields[campaign]=...`

Member.description: The record of a user's membership to a campaign. Replaces the v1 Pledge resource. All fields must be explicitly requested via `fields[member]=...`

campaign_lifetime_support_cents.description: Total lifetime support in campaign's currency cents.

currently_entitled_amount_cents.description: Amount in cents the member is currently entitled to.

is_follower.description: Deprecated. Always false — following replaced by free membership.

is_gifted.description: True if membership is from a gift.

last_charge_status.description: Result of last charge attempt. Only `Paid` indicates a successful payment.

note.description: Creator's private notes on the member.

patron_status.description: Null indicates the member has never pledged.

Tier.description: A membership tier on a campaign. v2 equivalent of v1 Reward. All fields must be requested via `fields[tier]=...`

Benefit.description: A benefit added to the campaign, assignable to tiers. Request fields via `fields[benefit]=...`

Goal.description: A funding goal on a campaign. [DEPRECATED] Goals relationship on Campaign will always be empty.

Address.description: A patron's shipping address. Requires `campaigns.members.address` scope. Request fields via `fields[address]=...`

Post.description: A post published on a campaign. Requires `campaigns.posts` scope. Request fields via `fields[post]=...`

content.description: HTML content of the post. Only available for posts the token holder can access.

is_paid.description: True if the post was paid for by patrons.

Webhook.description: A v2 webhook on a campaign. Created per-client. Requires `w:campaigns.webhook` scope. Request fields via `fields[webhook]=...`

paused.description: If true, webhook will not fire. PATCH with `paused: false` to resume and replay missed events.

secret.description: HMAC-MD5 secret for verifying X-Patreon-Signature header on incoming payloads.
